_note: Hand-drawn map of eastern Kharse, the Valley of Ertrugol and western Boddendell (original_data/maps/kharse_ertrugol.jpg, 1648x2000). Coordinates are picture pixels, y down. north = the Inner Sea shore, south = the south-west coast; land is the area between them, extended past the paper edges. Traced by tools/ke_trace.mjs.
